name: n8n
description: n8n - Free and open fair-code licensed node based Workflow Automation Tool. Deploy to Heroku with PostgreSQL.

GENERIC_TIMEZONE.description: Your timezone (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo). Find yours at https://momentjs.com/timezone/.

N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A random 32+ character string used to encrypt credentials. Generate one: openssl rand -hex 20

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Must match your Heroku app URL. Replace <app-name> with your actual Heroku app name.

N8N_HOST.description: Your Heroku app hostname (e.g. your-app-name.herokuapp.com). Do NOT include protocol.

N8N_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol for webhook URLs. Heroku uses HTTPS.

DB_POSTGRESDB_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED.description: SSL is required to connect to Postgres on Heroku.
